All in ground swimming pools or the entire property on which they are located shall be fenced or walled to prevent uncontrolled/unauthorized access. The fence or wall shall be fenced by up to an 8 foot fence if it is in the interior of a lot. Fences or walls shall be installed within fifteen days or pool installation. Above ground pools are exempt from fence or wall requirements if they are at least 6 feet in height. Above ground pools that are less than 6 feet in height require fences as specified above for in ground pools.
